Engineered Projects
& Case Studies.

Every aquatic environment presents unique biological, hydraulic and chemical demands. Explore completed projects across Southern Africa and the Seychelles — including Southern Africa’s first salmon hatchery, a sea urchin hatchery, farm solar systems up to 150 kW, and specialist water engineering.

First in Southern Africa
A MILESTONE FOR SOUTHERN AFRICAN AQUACULTURE

First Salmon Hatchery in Southern Africa

Deep Blue Aqua built the first salmon hatchery in Southern Africa — a landmark project for aquaculture in the region. The installation brings our specialist hatchery engineering experience to salmon production, from the hatchery space to its water treatment infrastructure.

Milestone: First salmon hatchery in Southern Africa
Species: Salmon
Region: Southern Africa
Scope: Hatchery construction and aquatic systems

COASTAL WATER FILTRATION

High-Capacity Coastal Seawater Filtration Plant

Engineered to protect land-based marine aquaculture operations against harmful algal blooms (red tides) and extreme turbidity while ensuring uninterrupted supply of pristine seawater.

Flow Rate: 1,200,000 L/h (1.2 ML/h)
Application: Coastal Red Tide Mitigation & Filtration
Location: West Coast, Western Cape, SA
Key Tech: High-rate multi-vessel sand filtration, automated backwash cycle, high-volume degassing towers, coastal pumping station

Commercial Greenhouse Aquaponics Facility

Complete design and installation of an integrated commercial aquaponics greenhouse. Recirculates fish culture effluent through physical drum filtration and bio-mineralisation to feed extensive deep-water culture hydroponic beds.

Scale: Commercial Deep-Water Culture (DWC)

Location: Western Cape, South Africa
Key Tech: Faivre drum solids separation, biological nitrification loops, water reuse >95%
